'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Unknown Player LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Unknown Player]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).

Name blank on the Day 1 sheet.

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
